description: Imagineer13's rank-32 anti-burn LoRA (310 MB, ComfyUI diffusion_model.* keys), trained to stop the contrast build-up, over-sharpened skin and crunchy texture that compound across H3 continuation segments. Loads through load_lora_weights alongside the turbo adapter (lem, 2026-11-02, #1159). The file name names neither fl2v nor ref2v, so validate warns adapter_unrecognized; only fl2va has been tried. On a seed-42 five-segment guide chain (39 guide frames, 960x544, turbo-4step-keyframe at 5 steps) the unaided chain had burnt skin, knit and wall by segment 5; 0.6 on segments 2-5 held segment 1's look with a slight softening of fine texture; 0.4 let the burn partly back in by segment 5
use_when: continuation segments only, never segment 1; needs a hand-built chain until a chain option exists

evidence.note: Load check: fl2va with turbo plus anti-burn 0.6 ran clean, no unmatched-key warning; differs from turbo-only job e82ea2430448 (PSNR 22.75 dB, SSIM 0.78)
Arm A: five-segment guide chain without anti-burn - skin, knit and flat wall burnt by segment 5 (frame 421)
Arm B: the same chain with 0.6 on segments 2-5 - segment 1's look held through segment 5, fine knit slightly softened
Arm C: 0.4 on segments 2-5 - better than none, but the burn partly returns by segment 5
